meta.note: Minors are the consolidated list; full per-searcher reports are in 2026-11-22-user-issues.md.

findings.title: GUI tab never loads for a local-directory plugin
findings.user_sees: No Swarm titlebar pill, panel tab, Ctrl+Shift+S, or /swarm-board; /api/plugin reports only server; /api/plugin/gui returns 404 PluginNotFoundError.
findings.fix: Ship as a named package (or root gui-experimental.cjs + rpc export); verify features:{server,gui,rpc} and /api/plugin/gui; restart Desktop.

findings.title: Clean clone cannot load the plugin before bun install
findings.user_sees: After clone, tools and commands are absent and the failure is silent; plugin entry imports @opencode/plugin at runtime while node_modules is gitignored.
findings.fix: Add mandatory install as Quick Start step 1; log a loud startup error if entry cannot import.

findings.title: Board is not conversation-scoped and hides completed swarms
findings.user_sees: conversationId ignored, always getActiveSwarms()[0]; after complete the board says 'No swarm'; with two active swarms it shows the older one; ?swarmId ignored by UI.
findings.fix: Resolve by conversationId over all statuses, include swarmId in open_board/iframe, and order/limit active swarms.

findings.title: 3 of 5 advertised tabs are unreachable
findings.user_sees: Overview, Graph, Raw are hidden; only Board and Members render. Forcing Graph shows replay/GIF works.
findings.fix: Port the main.mjs snapshot wrapper (view.exists/json, graphTab, rawTab, raw, member) or remove the tabs and 5-tab claim; add a contract test.

findings.title: Reload/restart mid-swarm bricks the coordinator
findings.user_sees: Workers stop, board says interrupted, and the main chat rejects edits/writes forever; complete says 'not part of an active swarm'; only a new chat escapes.
findings.fix: Skip reconcile when owner_pid === process.pid; persist coordinator session IDs and clear/restore their permissions during reconcile.

findings.title: Isolated work is lost on complete/kill
findings.user_sees: branch mode creates the branch inside the clone then deletes the clone; share mode drops uncommitted changes via worktree remove --force.
findings.fix: Commit/merge or refuse cleanup when dirty; create branch work in the base repo or report the branch + merge command.

findings.title: Shipped roleModels pin opencode-go and are unvalidated
findings.user_sees: On a machine without opencode-go, first add fails or creates an unusable session; coordinator silently switches model; typos in worker/verifier defaults pass into session.create.
findings.fix: Unpin defaults (documented inheritance) or validate every role default and fail with a clear error before spawning.

findings.title: README never says how to start a swarm
findings.user_sees: Tools exist but the coordinator protocol is only injected by /swarm; users may get a coordinator that does the work itself.
findings.fix: Add Quick Start: /swarm <task>; /swarm-models lists models.

findings.title: Edit ownership and coordinator edit deny are undocumented
findings.user_sees: Basic add with name+brief creates a worker that cannot edit; coordinator edits fail while the swarm runs.
findings.fix: Document allowCoordinatorEdits, owned_globs/claim, workspace:share; or make basic add usable by default.

findings.title: fork is advertised but always fails
findings.user_sees: swarm add fork:... always errors because ctx.session.fork is absent from the v2 adapter.
findings.fix: Remove fork from schema/docs or implement via session.create(parentID)+replay.

findings.title: GUI-only features documented as universal; restart buried
findings.user_sees: CLI users get unknown /swarm-board; Desktop users see no tab even after opencode reload.
findings.fix: Label as Desktop-GUI-only, document restart, provide browser-board fallback.

findings.title: Host version requirement ambiguous; opencode not on PATH
findings.user_sees: CLI 2.2.6 lacks GUI/RPC; Desktop embeds 2.3.2; documented opencode commands fail in a fresh Windows shell.
findings.fix: State CLI >=2.2.6 (core) / Desktop 2.3.2+ (GUI, restart); document full path or PATH setup.

findings.title: Provider/auth/region/training prerequisites undocumented
findings.user_sees: swarm models can be empty or add fails without auth; contributor models imply consent that is never explained.
findings.fix: Add Prerequisites: auth login, Console region, Muse training opt-in.

findings.title: Isolation claims overstated; share/branch only see committed HEAD
findings.user_sees: Default is inherit; share/branch ignore uncommitted files; users expect current work.
findings.fix: Document default and require commit/copy before isolation modes; soften claim.

findings.title: Board URL/token/port failure modes undocumented
findings.user_sees: Fixed port conflict silently removes the board (open_board:''); bookmarks die on restart; bare host loads GET but POSTs 401.
findings.fix: Document ephemeral port/token; surface a visible warning on server failure; add swarmId to URL.

findings.title: Model examples are stale and absent from catalog
findings.user_sees: Copying anthropic/openai/glm-4.6 examples fails validation or is ignored.
findings.fix: Replace with placeholders pointing to swarm models.

findings.title: Verifier read-only and worker locks bypassed by shell allow
findings.user_sees: Verifier can sed -i/git checkout; parallel inherit workers overwrite each other via shell despite owned_globs.
findings.fix: Default verifier/worker shell to ask/deny; run verifier in read-only worktree; block shell-writes in inherit.

findings.title: Feed freezes after 500 posts
findings.user_sees: Tab count shows 505 but feed ends at #500; newest posts never appear.
findings.fix: Return newest page or beforeSeq paging; load older on scroll; surface hasMore.

findings.title: Members model/variant pickers absent
findings.user_sees: No selects/buttons on Members; POST endpoints have no client caller.
findings.fix: Render per-member model+variant selects and wire POST /api/member/model; or remove the claim.

findings.title: Unread divider never appears
findings.user_sees: No 'New' divider and no (you) chips because state.me is never returned.
findings.fix: Return member for conversationId and include it in etag.

findings.title: Duplicate #main channel tab
findings.user_sees: Channel strip shows All, #main, #main.
findings.fix: Filter main server-side or in renderChannels.

findings.title: New members get two queued prompts
findings.user_sees: First turn is only the board wake-up, the role/opening rules arrive second; duplicated tokens/work, or worker waits forever.
findings.fix: Do not wake a just-created member; post after opening prompt or merge into one prompt.

findings.title: Invalid variants accepted when a model has no variants
findings.user_sees: minimax#thinking / kimi#high returns ok; the provider ignores or fails later.
findings.fix: Reject a requested variant when the model's variants list is empty.

findings.title: Unregistered sessions hard-denied in permission.evaluate
findings.user_sees: A second chat/tab in the same project gets denied for every edit/shell while a swarm runs.
findings.fix: Enforce only for swarm-owned sessions/targets; allow unrelated sessions.

findings.title: Killed names cannot be reused; working members cannot switch model
findings.user_sees: kill then add same name fails; model switch refuses while working; no recovery path under the same name.
findings.fix: Implement generations or update killed rows; allow interrupt-then-switch; suggest a free name.

findings.title: Partial shard spawns leave phantom members
findings.user_sees: A failed shard leaves earlier shards live, killed rows, and orphan sessions/worktrees; retry collides.
findings.fix: Pre-validate all shards, insert atomically, roll back on failure; support per-shard globs.

findings.title: Quota-paused workers are never retried or woken
findings.user_sees: A 429 silently stops the worker; mentions do nothing; status shows paused but no recovery hint.
findings.fix: Retry with backoff after the window, add resume/retry, or wake on next mention with a fresh attempt.

findings.title: Wake/prompt failures are swallowed
findings.user_sees: post_message returns ok but the worker never responds; status hides last_error.
findings.fix: Return wake failures in post_message and include last_error in status/read_board status.

findings.title: /swarm injects JSON.stringify(prompt)
findings.user_sees: The user request arrives quoted/escaped with \n and attachments as JSON, not real files.
findings.fix: Use invocation.prompt.text and forward files/agents/skills.

findings.title: No lock-release action
findings.user_sees: Finished worker globs stay claimed; another worker is refused; only kill releases (and deletes its workspace).
findings.fix: Add swarm{action:'release',globs} and auto-release on [done]/complete.

findings.title: Tools disagree after completion; add silently starts a new swarm
findings.user_sees: status/read_board show the completed swarm, post_message/swarm_wait reject, add creates a new swarm.
findings.fix: Unify on active membership; return swarm:null/completed error; require explicit new/title.

findings.title: Two active swarms allowed; board binds to active[0]
findings.user_sees: Second chat's swarm is invisible or the board shows the older one; monitor handles both.
findings.fix: One active swarm per workspace, or explicit swarmId scoping everywhere.

findings.title: Stall monitor suppressed by one working member; stops after 3 nudges
findings.user_sees: One long-running worker hides a stalled coordinator; after 3 unanswered nudges monitoring goes silent.
findings.fix: Evaluate members independently; reset nudge counter on a time window.

findings.title: Killed/completed sessions point at deleted worktrees
findings.user_sees: Clicking a dead member opens a session whose cwd is gone; file tools fail with ENOENT.
findings.fix: Archive/remove child sessions on kill, or keep worktrees until acknowledged; mark dead sessions non-clickable.

findings.title: sandbox-test-repo is misconfigured and not a Git repo
findings.user_sees: Opening the sandbox loads no plugin; share/branch target the parent repo.
findings.fix: Use ../../tools/swarm-runtime (or a package) and git init the sandbox.

findings.title: Board server failure is silent
findings.user_sees: Port conflict or startup failure leaves open_board empty with only a console warning.
findings.fix: Surface a visible warning/toast and a retry action.

minors.title: CSP blocks Google Fonts
minors.fix: Set media=all from JS or self-host fonts.

minors.title: Raw tab always empty
minors.fix: Send raw:{members,board,view} or remove tab.

minors.title: Standalone member click is a no-op
minors.fix: Define toggleConversation only when embedded; toast a hint otherwise.

minors.title: postMessage uses '*' and checks origin only
minors.fix: Verify event.source and use the app origin.

minors.title: Empty-state copy wrong in embedded GUI
minors.fix: Propagate conversationId/embedded flag and adjust copy.

minors.title: Killed members counted/visible as live
minors.fix: Add killed flag or filter server-side.

minors.title: Poll errors show 'Reconnecting' forever
minors.fix: Surface status/error and retry; distinguish server errors.

minors.title: Every poll recomputes graph+catalog before etag
minors.fix: Cheap etag first or cache per head.

minors.title: Phantom @mentions from package paths
minors.fix: Require a member boundary or resolve against roster.

minors.title: Members rows are mouse-only
minors.fix: role=listitem/button, tabindex, Enter/Space, accessible name.

minors.title: Legacy Antigravity sidecar assets shipped and served
minors.fix: Label legacy or remove; main.mjs imports sidecar_sdk not in deps.

minors.title: opencode plugin list has no health status
minors.fix: Document /api/plugin health check or add a status command.

minors.title: PowerShell prints red tsc banner on success
minors.fix: Ignore/document or wrap output.

minors.title: No LICENSE
minors.fix: Add a license.

minors.title: Audit line references stale after fixes
minors.fix: Cite symbols or refresh line numbers.

minors.title: Worker prompt says it may spawn helpers, policy denies it
minors.fix: Remove the line or allow owner-scoped helpers.

minors.title: [done] substring can mark the author done
minors.fix: Only honor a leading [done] or mark_done=true.

minors.title: /swarm-models overclaims manual assignment
minors.fix: Print role defaults and default model, or fix copy.

minors.title: Windows raw git errors on repo with no commits
minors.fix: Detect empty repo and return a clear message.

minors.title: localhost may fail on IPv6-first Windows
minors.fix: Listen on localhost or normalize URLs to 127.0.0.1.
